LanguageData.Gun_AK-104_RWP.description: The AK-104 is a compact assault rifle known for its reliability and effectiveness in combat. Featuring a shorter barrel than the traditional AK series, it offers improved maneuverability in tight spaces while maintaining impressive firepower. Ideal for mid-range engagements, this weapon's robust design ensures it withstands the harsh conditions of RimWorld, delivering consistent performance time and again.
